queues.name: Name
queues.noTickets: Nothing in this queue right now.
queues.title: Queues
queues.truncated: Showing the first 50. Narrow the condition to see the rest.
requestTypes.description: Each form becomes one issue type. Answers land in the ticket.
requestTypes.empty: This portal has no forms yet.
requestTypes.fieldMappingHint: Which custom field holds the answer. Summary and details go into the ticket itself.
requestTypes.issueTypeFixed: The issue type is set when the form is created. Changing it would make every field mapping meaningless.
requestTypes.name: Name

sla.calendarsDescription: Shared across the installation. The calendar owns the timezone — an SLA is one promise, so it needs one clock.
sla.escalationsHint: What to do once a share of the target is used. 100% is the target itself; above that is after the miss.
sla.goalsHint: One line per target, first match wins. Last line must have no condition. For example: priority>=5 1h then 4h
sla.metricImmutable: What a policy measures cannot be changed — already-running clocks would start measuring something else. Make a new policy instead.
sla.name: Name
sla.noCalendars: No business calendars yet. A policy needs one.
sla.noStates: This project has no statuses to choose from — it needs an issue type first.
sla.pauseStatesHint: The clock stops while the ticket sits in one of these — use it for waiting on the customer.
sla.policiesDescription: A policy measures one thing: first response or resolution. Targets are checked against a business calendar, so nights and weekends do not count.
sla.title: SLA
sla.workingHoursHint: One line per weekday: Mon=0. For example 0 09:00-12:00 13:00-18:00
